children: On October 7, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it is not in compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below the threshold. Streamex has 180 days, until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days, and trading continues on Nasdaq under the symbol STEX.
